problem_statement: Facility output experienced an unexplained ~18.5% decline starting around Day 7.

planted_root_cause.physical_mechanism: Proportional coolant bypass valve stickiness resulting in coolant starvation (< 12 L/min vs 32 L/min nominal), leading to thermal throttling.
planted_root_cause.actual_impact: Machine M-03 output drops from ~95 units/hr to ~58 units/hr, dragging facility overall output down by ~18.5%.

planted_misleading_correlation.observation: Strong positive correlation between power draw and output (r = 0.72).
planted_misleading_correlation.trap: Interpreting power drop as the root cause (e.g. grid instability), when in fact power drops because the machine's safety governor throttles speed.

planted_confounder.observation: Higher RPM elevates spindle temperature across all machines, creating the false impression that high workload is the primary issue.

planted_data_quality_issues: Machine logs contain 8 duplicated telemetry rows.
Temperature sensor on M-03 suffered packet loss/downtime between Day 8 and Day 9 (null values).
Temperature records contain occasional raw text unit strings ('84.2 C' and one rogue '183 F').
